user_role_assignments_scope_shape_ck.name: user_role_assignments_scope_shape_ck
user_role_assignments_scope_shape_ck.value:
(
        ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'system' AND "user_role_assignments"."institution_id" IS NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."faculty_id" IS NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."department_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'institution' AND "user_role_assignments"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."faculty_id" IS NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."department_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'faculty' AND "user_role_assignments"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."faculty_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."department_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' AND "user_role_assignments"."institution_id" IS NOT NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."faculty_id" IS NULL AND "user_role_assignments"."department_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

user_role_assignments_role_scope_ck.name: user_role_assignments_role_scope_ck
user_role_assignments_role_scope_ck.value:
(
        ("user_role_assignments"."role" = 'system_administrator' AND "user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'system')
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."role" = 'institution_administrator' AND "user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'institution')
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."role" = 'faculty_administrator' AND "user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'faculty')
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."role" = 'department_administrator' AND "user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department')
        OR ("user_role_assignments"."role" IN ('student', 'lecturer', 'course_coordinator') AND "user_role_assignments"."scope_type" IN ('institution', 'faculty', 'department'))
      )

attendance_disputes_resolution_ck.name: attendance_disputes_resolution_ck
attendance_disputes_resolution_ck.value:
("attendance_disputes"."status" = 'open' AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "attendance_disputes"."resolution_note" IS NULL)
        OR ("attendance_disputes"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("attendance_disputes"."status" IN ('upheld', 'rejected') AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "attendance_disputes"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(btrim("attendance_disputes"."resolution_note")) >= 10)

attendance_records_revoked_at_ck.name: attendance_records_revoked_at_ck
attendance_records_revoked_at_ck.value: ("attendance_records"."status" = 'present' AND "attendance_records"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_records"."status" = 'revoked' AND "attendance_records"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

attendance_sessions_closed_at_ck.name: attendance_sessions_closed_at_ck
attendance_sessions_closed_at_ck.value: ("attendance_sessions"."status" = 'open' AND "attendance_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("attendance_sessions"."status" = 'closed' AND "attendance_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

venues_geofence_outline_shape_ck.name: venues_geofence_outline_shape_ck
venues_geofence_outline_shape_ck.value: "venues"."geofence_outline" IS NULL OR CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("venues"."geofence_outline") = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length("venues"."geofence_outline") BETWEEN 3 AND 24 ELSE false END

venues_active_location_ck.name: venues_active_location_ck
venues_active_location_ck.value: "venues"."status" <> 'active' OR ("venues"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "venues"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "venues"."geofence_radius_meters" IS NOT NULL AND "venues"."location_registered_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

staff_invitations_scope_shape_ck.name: staff_invitations_scope_shape_ck
staff_invitations_scope_shape_ck.value:
(
        ("staff_invitations"."role" = 'institution_administrator' AND "staff_invitations"."faculty_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."department_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("staff_invitations"."role" = 'faculty_administrator' AND "staff_invitations"."faculty_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."department_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("staff_invitations"."role" IN ('department_administrator', 'lecturer') AND "staff_invitations"."faculty_id" IS NULL AND "staff_invitations"."department_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

staff_invitations_outcome_ck.name: staff_invitations_outcome_ck
staff_invitations_outcome_ck.value:
NOT ("staff_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND (("staff_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("staff_invitations"."accepted_user_id" IS NULL))

class_representatives_scope_ck.name: class_representatives_scope_ck
class_representatives_scope_ck.value: ("class_representatives"."role" = 'hoc' AND "class_representatives"."department_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("class_representatives"."role" = 'ghoc' AND "class_representatives"."department_id" IS NULL)
